title.narrative: Driving Inclusive Action to Prevent Discrimination, GBV and Femicide in Eastern Africa

description.narrative: This workplan will consider persistent discrimination, gender inequality and GBV including femicide and technology-facilitated violence that continue to erode social cohesion across Eastern Africa, driven by entrenched norms and harmful masculinities. Shifting from reactive responses to transformative, evidence-based approaches, the workplan will leverage on the UNESCO Transforming MEN’talities initiative to strengthen data-driven action, particularly among youth and in higher education, while promoting digital counter-narratives. Disability inclusion will be integrated across interventions, supporting national strategies to address intersecting inequalities. Efforts will also draw on the Routes of Enslaved Peoples Programme to link historical legacies with present-day discrimination and advance intercultural dialogue, taking advantage of Umoja edutainment game developed last biennium, but also leveraging on the Human Rights Contest initiated last December 2025. Together, these actions will foster inclusive, whole-of-society pathways toward peace, justice, and resilience, while serving as foundational interventions for additional resource mobilization.
